payload.text: Origem Engenheiro: confirmei na Tower revisao sha256:82f1419f0c9840aa8942a26f3ec25f527a0e7bb8b725bc2c0b71ad63994b9333 os mesmos 47 TESTs com status DONE e execution_phase RUNNING.
